newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 29.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 29.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn says that some of the social security changes that took effect on January 1 of this year might be reviewed.
- Hungarian-Slovak talks on the implementation of the Basic (friendship) Treaty between the two countries.
- More dead in the Hungarian flu epidemic.
- Two dead, 43 injured in bus accident in eastern Hungary.
- Budapest Bank won't be floated on the stock exchange.
- The Agrarian Products Marketing Centre is starting to operate this year.
